changes_from_v1: Forward GT flow samples frame 1 onto frame 0, not the reverse.
Warp errors exclude out-of-bounds and forward/backward-inconsistent pixels.
Absolute temporal errors include static clips; undefined ratios are null.
Paired better counts use metric direction; amplitude ratios have no better direction.
metric_schema.band_definition: lowband=U(D(x)); detail=x-U(D(x)); D=antialiased bicubic downsample, U=bicubic upsample
metric_schema.band_interpretation: A complementary frequency-band diagnostic, not an orthogonal projection or a physical observation/null-space decomposition. GT substitution is an oracle diagnostic, not achievable recovery.

flow.source: GT only, Farneback in both directions
flow.limitation: Forward/backward consistency is an occlusion heuristic, not ground-truth visibility.

metric_schema.paired_difference: a-b; ci95 is bootstrap CI of the mean, median is median of paired differences
metric_schema.comparability: Recompute all compared arms under v2; do not relabel old JSON as v2 or mix v1/v2 warp and aggregate statistics.

contract.target: original uint8 hr from matching RGB NPZ; no decoded latent GT

inference_merge.rounding: BF16 storage rounds the merged weight once; separate-branch bit parity is not claimed

scope: 8-source existing x4 development windows; not native multi-task omni or frozen test evidence
